steps.what: Read the applicable product quality criteria
Perform the physical quality checks on products and parts
Enter actual product quality results in the existing inspection record
Save the quality entry in its existing inspection screen

tasks.design: Link the correct inspection specification to the job in {OPS_SYSTEM} and prefill its existing job identifiers. The assembler performs the actual checks and enters the observations; {OTHER} means existing gauges and test equipment, whose runtime is already present.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the right revision and entering job identifiers interrupt inspection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native job-linked inspection forms can remove these small navigation and entry costs.
tasks.still_hard: A clean form cannot establish the part's physical condition or measurement validity.
tasks.human_edge: Notice unexpected defects and challenge a questionable measurement.

ambition.what: Inspection responsibility remains with the assembler.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: job-linked inspection forms can reduce identifier entry, while physical inspection and interpretation still require validated methods.

assumptions: Boundary includes an actual inspection record used by quality staff for traceability, but not a formal product release. No extra report is invented.

Production planning supplies job id and variant; engineering supplies specification id, revision and limits. The assembler produces observations in s2 and captures result, measured value and defect code in s3. Missing links are resolved manually within retained reading and incremental repair.

s1 removes two units of revision navigation. s3 removes1.4 units of repeated identifiers, retaining12.6 for actual observations and checking. Existing automatic test capture earns no saving; no new sensors are assumed.
The ordinary save is minimal, fully retained and ungated. Shares are illustrative rather than measured.
unknowns: Whether the current inspection screen already prefills identifiers
Which results are already captured by equipment
research_questions: Can the linked specification always match the actual product revision?

already_counted.description: Read criteria, physically inspect, capture and save actual observations

incremental.description: Repair variant links and maintain form defaults

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R96.6 gross3.4 minus upkeep1 gives2.4. For a mixed-revision job with no reusable identifier defaults, s1 retains9 of10 and entry14 of14. Gross1 minus upkeep1 gives0; physical work and save remain76.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review orders and blueprints for correct assembly

steps.what: Retrieve the current work orders, blueprints and specifications
Review blueprints and work orders against the actual assembly requirements

tasks.design: Configure job-specific links from {OPS_SYSTEM} to released drawings in {DOCS}. The assembler still reads dimensions, notes and procedures and resolves ambiguity through the existing engineering route.
tasks.previous_blocker: Orders and current drawings are retrieved separately.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document references can remove repeated searching without interpreting drawings automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Variant details and conflicting instructions require assembly knowledge.
tasks.human_edge: Connect the drawing with the real component and spot a mismatch.

ambition.what: The assembler keeps the same responsibility for understanding instructions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: released-drawing links can reduce retrieval effort but do not replace technical drawing interpretation.

assumptions: Boundary is reviewing current instructions, with no routine review report invented. Actual engineering clarification or an amended drawing is separate work when a conflict occurs.

Planning produces the job and variant; engineering maintains drawing id, revision, release status and document location. Missing references are retrieved manually within retained s1 work and repair upkeep.
Five of twenty-five retrieval units are duplicate navigation; twenty remain for reading identifiers and checking revision. Existing document retrieval runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Frequency of stale or conflicting drawing revisions
research_questions: Do direct links preserve visible revision and release status?

already_counted.description: Check matched revisions and interpret the instructions

incremental.description: Repair broken links and incorrect variant mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R95 gross5 minus upkeep1 gives4. For legacy drawings without variant metadata, retrieval retains24 of25 and interpretation75, giving gross1 minus upkeep1=0.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read current work demand, staffing and procedure constraints
Determine work assignments and appropriate released procedures
Enter the determined work assignments in the existing team roster
Check the final work assignments against actual availability and qualifications
Send the authorized work assignments to the assembly team
Save the work roster in the existing system

tasks.design: Group current demand and qualifications in {OPS_SYSTEM} and reuse valid roster rows instead of retyping stable details. The assembler decides the allocation and checks the complete version before {CHAT} delivers it to the team.
tasks.previous_blocker: Planning views and the team's actual roster are separate, and assignments are copied again into messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing roster templates and event-linked messages handle the repeated clerical work.
tasks.still_hard: Fatigue, changed availability and unfamiliar jobs can override a formally valid allocation.
tasks.human_edge: Make fair and safe allocations with knowledge of the team.

ambition.what: Reconsider rotation when a bottleneck changes during a shift.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: roster reuse and snapshot-linked messaging can reduce clerical assignment work while team allocation decisions remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is a team assembler acting as the team's existing assignment coordinator, including its actual roster and team message. Do not add these records where a team only uses a verbal allocation.

Planning produces job id, quantity, due time and procedure revision; the existing skills roster owner maintains worker qualifications. The coordinator checks actual availability in s2 and s4. Missing values remain manual; no worker monitoring or inferred behaviour scores are introduced.
s1 removes three units of view switching; s3 removes five of repeated row details, retaining fifteen for changed assignments and verification. Save time is tiny, fully retained and ungated.

s4 is the real final allocation and recipient check before communicating operative instructions, not approval to save the author's document. Changes to any assignment, procedure or recipient void it. Native messaging already present earns no saving.
unknowns: Whether the team has an actual digital assignment roster
research_questions: Can the final recipient message exactly match the authorized roster?

already_counted.description: Read constraints, decide allocations, complete the roster, check the final assignments and save

incremental.description: Repair roster templates and failed delivery, maintain qualification links

approvals.approved_version: Exact roster, procedure references and team recipients checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R88 gross12 minus upkeep2 gives10. On a nonstandard job with little reusable roster content, lookup retains19 of20 and entry19 of20; decision45, check10 and save1 remain. R94, gross6 minus upkeep2 gives4, including only the actual four-unit message saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the relevant job procedures before training or supervising assemblers
Supervise assemblers, demonstrate job procedures and check actual practice

tasks.design: Provide direct links to the released job procedure in {DOCS}. Supervision, demonstration and feedback stay at the station with the team assembler.
tasks.previous_blocker: The current reference can require a small amount of searching.
tasks.enabler_now: Native procedure links remove that navigation without changing the instruction itself.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding appears in actual practice, not in opening a document.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a struggling employee and correct unsafe or ineffective technique.

ambition.what: Live supervision and training remain the main duty.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: direct procedure links can save limited reference search; physical demonstration and supervision remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is routine station supervision and practical training, not certification. No training completion register is invented; where certification requires one, its actual entry and authorized release must be mapped separately.
Engineering maintains procedure id, revision and released document. The assembler reads original instructions if links fail. One of ten reference units is navigation; nine remain for reading.
No employee recording, performance scoring or new structured capture is introduced. Existing document runtime earns no benefit.
unknowns: Whether this training includes a real mandatory completion record
research_questions: Do staff already have the current procedure at the station?

already_counted.description: Read the current reference and supervise actual practice

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R99 gross1 minus upkeep0.5 gives0.5. For unfamiliar procedures requiring full source navigation, reference work retains9.5 of10; gross0.5 minus upkeep0.5 gives0. No invented training report is added to create a benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The assembler keeps hands-on quality, drawing interpretation, fair allocation and practical training, with less repeated navigation and entry.
role.ambitious_version: Use modest clerical gains to revisit bottlenecks while protecting inspection and teaching time.
